jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.
* 7 years of experience using analytics or applying project management tools to address business issues.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Project Management certifications such as PMP, Six Sigma, etc.
* Experience with managing digital advertising, Google Ads, campaign building and optimization.
* Experienced with the GCS Incentive system (Points, UAAs, Spend Bands, Offerings, etc).
* Experience in early customer lifecycle stages (i.e. Onboarding and Acquisition).
* Understanding of selling best practice and techniques (e.g., objection handling, competitive selling).
* Excellent sales performance analysis skills, along with the ability to manage sales activities and metrics, diagnose performance issues, and translate insights into recommendations.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you will play a critical role on the frontlines of Google Customer Solutions (GCS) vendor sales management. You will be the principal stakeholder for your vendor management team, influencing and holding them accountable to deliver excellent sales performance and quality while enabling site\-program success with targeted support.  

  

You will be responsible for analyzing vendor performance and presenting key insights to Google sales leadership, supporting initiatives to improve GCS vendor operations, and sharing best practices with vendor management and Google teams across global markets and lines of business.  

  

This role is aligned to the AUNZ market and will require working non standard hours.The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build quarterly strategy in collaboration with vendor leaders, monitor weekly sales performance metrics, and share key market performance insights with Google sales leadership via weekly updates and monthly reviews.
* Ensure vendor service quality against contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by conducting regular call audits, calibration sessions, and quality reviews.
* Build influential, trusted partner relationships with vendor sales management (e.g., Senior Manager), communicating rigorous expectations for delivering against program\-specific agreement terms while providing appropriate support, best practices, and guidance.
* Provide critical on\-the\-ground feedback and support to land vendor operations improvement initiatives led by central Google teams.
* Find opportunities and execute on cross GCS collaborations to enable smooth customer outreach, graduations, and more.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. **Strong plus**

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Business Onboarding Verification
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**About Wise**
 Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low\-cost, and safe.
   

  

 Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
   

  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.


 Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market\-specific requirements.
   

  

 That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
   

  

 These are not generic AI, programme management, or stakeholder coordination roles. You will coordinate complex work, but the core of the job is product ownership: defining the problem, shaping the solution, making trade\-offs explicit, setting success metrics, launching safely, and ensuring each change improves KYB as a product.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Own the product roadmap for one BOV workstream, from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the highest\-value problems using customer friction, operational cost, manual review load, risk impact, regulatory need, and delivery readiness.
* Translate ambiguous KYB problems into clear product requirements, launch criteria, success metrics, and learning loops.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics/Data Science, Product Compliance, Risk, Operations, regional teams, vendors, support partners, and adjacent PMs.
* Define launch metrics and guardrails across customer impact, manual review load, operational adoption, control quality, false positives, false negatives, auditability, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build feedback loops from agents, QA, assurance, customer outcomes, support contacts, downstream risk signals, and vendor/model performance where relevant.
* Balance tactical delivery with long\-term product foundations.


**What Success Looks Like In The First 6\-12 Months**
* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.
* The team has shipped meaningful product improvements, not just analysis or coordination.
* Product changes are safer to launch because metrics, guardrails, monitoring, fallback paths, and ownership are clear.
* Cross\-functional partners understand what is being solved, why it matters, who owns what, and how success will be measured.
* KYB becomes faster, more measurable, more auditable, and easier for legitimate businesses and agents to navigate.


**This Role Gives You The Opportunity To**
* Work on one of the most important regulated onboarding domains at Wise.
* Improve the experience for business customers and the agents reviewing their cases.
* Build practical AI, automation, decisioning, controls, and platform foundations in a real operational environment.
* Work across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Analytics, regional teams, and vendors on high\-stakes problems.
* Shape how Wise moves from fragmented manual review and tactical control work toward reusable, measurable KYB capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**
* You have product management experience owning complex work from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* You are comfortable in data\-heavy, risk\-sensitive, operational, regulated, onboarding, payments, trust and safety, compliance, or fintech domains.
* You can reason with data and metrics, including denominators, baselines, segmentation, sample bias, data quality, attribution limits, and guardrails.
* You can translate ambiguous product, risk, compliance, or operational problems into clear requirements, launch criteria, and iteration plans.
* You understand that regulated product delivery needs evidence, auditability, operational readiness, monitoring, and ownership.
* You communicate clearly, make trade\-offs explicit, and can create alignment without formal authority.


**Strong Additional Signals**
* Experience in KYB, KYC, business onboarding, financial crime, identity, fraud, risk decisioning, compliance tooling, operational tooling, payments, or regulated fintech.
* Experience with AI, LLMs, ML models, document intelligence, decisioning systems, vendor evaluation, or agent\-assist tooling.
* Experience turning remediation, audit,…

IND Scrum Master \- GCC027
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

**Job Description: Scrum Master**

* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Employment Type: Full\-Time
* Experience Level: 4\-6 years

**About The Company**


We are leader in Property and Casualty insurance, employee benefits and mutual funds. Once of the largest insurers in the United States with many decades of expertise, this company is widely recognized for its service excellence, sustainability practices, trust and integrity.

**Position Overview**


We are seeking a Scaled Agile **Scrum Master.** The Scrum Master will be part of a team delivering business capabilities and customer value in alignment with the portfolio strategic roadmap, and is a critical role that facilitates ceremonies for an agile team, arranges daily stand\-up meetings, and facilitates/schedules meetings, demo and decision\-making processes.


In this role, the individual coaches **an agile team** and removes impediments by escalating when appropriate, and acts as a trusted partner with the Product Owner, Release Train Engineer and leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Servant leader who facilitates and coaches an agile team in Scrum Principles and best practices, depending on line of business
* Facilitates ceremonies for the agile team with direction from Sr. Scrum Masters, RTEs, and strong oversight from Agile Coaches
* Arranges daily stand\-up meetings, facilitates/schedules meetings, demo and decision\-making processes in order to ensure quick inspection and proper use of adaptation process with some oversight
* Ensures teams adhere to established governance models with oversight
* Serve as a liaison between agile teams and all project stakeholders
* Provides information regarding team health (people, process, progress and overall satisfaction) to Technology and Business Leaders
* Work with product managers and development teams to assure requirements are captured and recorded using agile methodology
* Understands product planning in an inspect and adapt environment, and ensures the Product Owner prioritizes Product Backlog to maximize value
* Understands and communicates business value of new work
* Influences key members of their Agile team (Product Owner, Software Engineers, etc.) to improve and change behaviors to agile ways of working
* Applies conflict resolution practices and principles to promote teamwork
* Tracks and communicates the overall team progress, providing visibility to stakeholders (i.e. Retrospectives, Sprint Planning)
* Partners with the Product Owner, IT Delivery Lead and Business leadership to form execution delivery plans and manage progress
* Provides coaching to the Scrum Team(s) on agile principles, servant leadership, and executing Scrum frameworks
* Participates in and seeks mentorship from the Scrum Master / RTE CoP
* Analyzes the efficiency of the development team through standard metrics
* Helps with change management activities around agile ways of working
* Mitigates work blockages, shielding team from outside distractions
* Assesses maturity of the agile team and coaches team to higher levels
* Builds a trusted environment where problems can be raised without blame or retribution, with an emphasis on teamwork and problem solving

**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* 4 \- 6 years of relevant work experience, including digital, technology, or project management fields
* Familiarity with the insurance industry
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and frameworks such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Scrum, Kanban, XP, etc.
* Working knowledge of Agile techniques: User Stories, Continuous Integration, Test\-driven Development, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Burn\-down Metrics, Velocity etc.
* Experience with agile lifecycle management tools (e.g., Rally, JIRA) and toolsets such as Agile Central
* Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Teams
* Strong collaboration skills, including ability to work with stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability understand audiences and tailor messages
* Familiarity with analyzing data to identify insights and create hypotheses for testing
* Self\-motivated individual with ability to handle multiple high\-priority demands, manage expectations and achieve objectives
* Able to handle basic scope, complexity, and metrics monitoring within an agile team

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* First level Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I) **preferred**

**What We Offer:**

* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities

Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

Pod 1 – Platform AI \& Integration focuses on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the enterprise Knowledge Graph, and AI\-powered developer workflows, while Pod 2 – Platform \& AI Accelerators focuses on platform accelerators, Terraform\-based cloud provisioning (CCP→CCPNext), and Backstage Golden Paths. Together the pods enable intelligent automation, faster developer productivity, and consistent AI adoption across the enterprise — connecting data, systems, and context so engineering teams can move faster with greater confidence.
   

  

 We are hiring two Product Owners — one embedded on each of the two Platform pods (one on Pod 1 – Platform AI \& Integration and one on Pod 2 – Platform \& AI Accelerators). * Prepare backlog for PI Planning and decide which work items become part of the team backlog
* Serve as the customer proxy

* Partner in Scrum ceremonies such as iteration planning, iteration reviews, and demos
* Help create user stories and define acceptance criteria
* Review and accept user stories as complete
* Contribute to vision and program Backlog
* Meet with stakeholders to ensure features and subsequent stories meet expectations
* Drive iteration content by prioritizing user stories
* May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders

* Ability to be organized with strong attention to detail and capable of coordinating multiple viewpoints into a single message
* Ability to understand technical issues
* Skilled in analytics and problem solving with a high attention to detail
* Ability to anticipate risks, issues and opportunities, and escalate them accordingly
* Skilled in presentation, facilitation, communication, and negotiation
* Ability to be comfortable and articulate in challenging change management scenarios, knowing when to insert self and when to fade back
* Solid knowledge in Agile including the value and principles, and how they are applied in enterprise environments


 Education
   

  

* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training


**Experience**
* Required: Intermediate\-level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in:
+ Agile and Scrum software development methodologies
+ Business analysis, project management or software development delivering enterprise products and solutions
+ 2\-5 years of relevant work\-related experience
+ Platform product management: vision, roadmap, OKRs, prioritization
+ Deep understanding of AI platform lifecycle (MLOps/LLMOps), personas and workflows
+ Stakeholder leadership across Security, Data, Infra, App teams; executive communication
+ Value measurement: adoption funnels, ROI/unit economics, service SLAs
+ Backlog ownership: epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning
+ AWS/AICP fluency (SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore) to make tradeoffs


* Preferred: Experience
+ API/SDK and developer experience strategy
+ Responsible AI \& governance frameworks
+ FinOps familiarity for AI workloads (cost per inference/training)
+ Change management for enterprise platform rollouts
+ Experience launching internal products with self\-service onboarding

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a passionate, self\-driven, energetic, and technical Senior Product Owner (PO) to join our R\&D development team, with a focus on our SaaS platform group. In this role, you will bridge the gap between market requirements from Product Management and the technical solutions implemented in our products. You will translate product requirements into actionable tasks for the development team—considering non\-functional requirements (NFRs), customer needs, service health, and more—while aiming to deliver best\-of\-breed products. Using comprehensive business and technical knowledge, you will own the developed solution and guide the entire development process, from planning through testing to successful release. You will work closely with Development Teams, Product Management, Professional Services, Technical Writers, and R\&D management, serving as the central focal point for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Analyze product business requirements and produce functional designs for CyberArk SaaS solutions, ensuring alignment with overall product capabilities.
   

  

 Own the product backlog: Deconstruct large features into smaller, prioritized pieces that compose a releasable product, while continuously validating and reviewing backlog value for prioritization and completeness.
   

  

 Review and refine business requirements, incorporating deep knowledge of the product, its customer use cases, SaaS architectures, and cloud environments to support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Serve as the central focal point for all parties inside and outside R\&D on how the product works, its capabilities, and the impact of changes; raise connections across R\&D groups and other departments through sessions, demos, and collaborative reviews.
   

  

 Utilize expertise in cloud environments and deployments to own the service technical roadmap, ensuring it supports CyberArk's broader SaaS business roadmap.
   

  

 Lead large, high\-visibility projects involving multiple development teams, explaining requirements, answering functional questions, and driving proactive collaboration.
   

  

 Ensure, in partnership with line managers, that ongoing deliveries are presented on time and produce valuable content that meets customer needs.
   

  

 Foster innovation by thinking out of the box to enhance product solutions and address complex challenges at the OS level.

**Job title** : Insight analyst

**About Opella**
================

Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people' s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com .


**About the role**
==================

**Plan and lead cross\-channel performance analysis activities to identify patterns, risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations across Search and Programmatic channels. Ensure alignment of insights with business objectives by translating data into strategic narratives, optimization roadmaps, and forward\-looking recommendations for stakeholders.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Main Responsibilities**
=========================

* Lead cross\-channel analysis across Search and Programmatic to identify optimization opportunities and risks.

* Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insight narratives.
* Deep understanding of SEM and Programmatic performance levers.
* Knowledge of cross\-channel attribution and measurement methodologies.
* Proficiency in data visualization and analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Adobe Analytics).
* Strong communication and stakeholder presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple analyses and priorities simultaneously.

*

**Good to Have Skills**

* Incrementality \& Experimentation Analysis
* Competitive \& Market Trend Analysis

**Minimum Experience Required**

* 4–7 years of experience in media analytics, performance insights, or marketing analytics roles.

**Educational Qualification**

* 15 years of full\-time education is required

**Summary**

As an Insights Manager, you will lead cross\-channel performance analysis to uncover trends, risks, and growth opportunities across paid media channels. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include analyzing performance reports, conducting deep\-dive studies, building strategic narratives, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders.


You will guide reporting specialists, align analytics outputs across regions, and ensure insights directly inform optimization strategies and future media planning decisions.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

jobs.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a passionate **Senior Business Analyst** to join an Agile team focused on modernizing and building a next\-gen digital application stack for Securities Operations and Corporate Action systems in the investment banking domain.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with Global Securities Management and Operations teams across all business areas to deliver global solutions for varied business requirements.


If you enjoy handling complex business processes, translating them into clear IT requirements, and shaping the evolution of a product through its lifecycle in a challenging, technology\-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

* Shape up business\-driven IT solutions for the Corporate Actions \& Income Processing department
* Collaborate with Operations \& Business teams to translate complex business requirements into meaningful IT requirements
* Independently drive data, function, and behavioral analysis
* Act as an intrinsic part of IT Agile scrum teams and help execute deliveries in line with business acceptance criteria
* Assist in quality control and project management
* Take lead on front\-to\-back testing activities
* Manage senior stakeholder expectations

**Requirements**

* 6\-10 years of experience in Product Management within Investment Banking or similar areas
* Background in business analysis techniques for requirement refinement, including BRD and FRD
* Experience driving and managing backlog for scrum teams in a global context
* Expertise in defining technology and operational\-business process frameworks
* Proficiency in Agile (scrum\-based) delivery and related project management using Jira
* Capability to lead front\-to\-back testing and coordinate across multiple global teams
* Proficiency in SQL, Unix, and messaging tools, with the ability to analyze and interpret large data sets
* Competency in stakeholder management and requirement gathering
* Passion for greenfield development and willingness to quickly upskill on the digital stack
* Familiarity with tools that aid business analysis
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Adaptability to work across teams and functions, with fluency in English (B2 level)

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to flow tools such as GitLab and Power BI
* Familiarity with behavioral test frameworks (e.g., JBehave, Cucumber)
* Experience working with digital platforms such as Kafka, Kibana, and Elasticsearch

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Data Center Finance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is a fast paced, dynamic, high\-tech Company based in Seattle, with offices and employees around the globe. Amazon has a history and tradition of leading the world in Web\-related technologies and services. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud.
  

  

AWS has an immediate opening in India for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Data Center Finance team in Asia\-Pacific. In this role you will work with regional AWS leadership to lead financial controllership of AWS Data Center Community and improve financial performance.
  

  

On the AWS Finance team, you will be surrounded by people that are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven, and believe that world class support is critical to customer success. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and razor\-sharp accuracy. We take working hard, having fun, and making history seriously and you should too! We provide end\-to\-end financial support driving AWS to be the low\-cost provider in Cloud computing and leader in customer experience. This includes supporting business owners in designing, building, operating and innovating our data centers. We support operations, business development, construction and carbon free energy. You should be passionate about producing financial analysis enabling management to make breakthrough decisions, drive cash flow, and ultimately delight our customers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the key business partner working directly AWS senior management and other internal stakeholders to provide financial recommendations.
* Partner with business to create and execute sourcing and supply management strategies.
* Report on the financial performance and lead in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial forecasts and reviews.
* Ability to communicate data clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.
* Work across teams on cost savings projects, automation and improvement initiatives with finance, construction, IT and design.
* Develop ad hoc business analysis and present recommendations to AWS senior management.
* Monitor compliance with controls and systems and develop new processes to support the fast\-growing, global AWS business.

  

A day in the life  

This role will partner will multiple stakeholders including finance and business leadership to provide insight, analysis and financial leadership as we rapidly expand and evolve the AWS Data Center business. This role will provide extensive cross\-functional opportunities to partner with teams. This role will drive how AWS thinks about strategic input drivers to continuously improve the economics of the business.  

  

About the team  

The Asia\-Pacific Data Center Finance team operates in a fast\-paced environment where high judgment is essential to our success. We partner closely with business leaders to provide strategic financial guidance that shapes directly impacts AWS growth in the region. Team members are encouraged to think creatively, challenge assumptions, and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.  

  

Our work directly impacts major business decisions, and we take pride in working collaboratively to translate financial insights into actionable strategies. We're looking for someone who shares our commitment and can thrive in an environment that values both analytical rigor and strategic thinking.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
* 4\+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
* 4\+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision\-making experience
* 4\+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA, or CPA
* Experience working with large\-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job title – Senior Expert GES DTS ServiceNow (SNOW \- Business Analyst)**

**Location – Hyderabad, India**

  

At dsm\-firmenich we strive to achieve a world where you don’t have to choose between taste, texture, or health \- and can enjoy it all. Our innovative ingredients, expertise, and solutions bridge the gap between the delicious, the nutritious, and the sustainable.


In this role you will play the role of ServiceNow Business Analyst ,accountable for translating business needs, process requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clear, actionable requirements for the ServiceNow platform. This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.


At dsm\-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers \& Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.

 **Your key responsibilities**

  



1\.Business Analysis \& Requirements Management

  

* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out\-of\-the\-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.

  

2\.Process Design \& ServiceNow Solution Alignment

  

* Analyze current\-state processes and support the design of future\-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServieNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.


3\. Backlog, Delivery \& Testing Support

  

* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.

  

4\. Governance, Controls \& Change Readiness

  

* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.

  

5\. Reporting, Insights \& Continuous Improvement

  

* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data\-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.

  

6\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Collaboration

  

* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow\-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics

 **We bring**

* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.

 **You bring**

  



* 6\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst – Change Management
jobs.description:
**Lead Business Analyst – Change Management** 




**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking a
 **Lead Business Analyst with deep organisational change management expertise** 
 to partner with clients delivering complex business, technology, and transformation programs. The successful candidate will act as the change lead on engagements — assessing change impact, shaping change strategies, engaging stakeholders, and driving adoption of new ways of working across the client's people, processes, and platforms.
 



 This is a client\-facing consultative role at the intersection of business analysis and change management. The individual must be equally comfortable running impact assessments and requirements workshops as they are coaching executive sponsors, designing communications, and standing up change networks. They will typically be embedded within a program leadership team and expected to shape the change agenda from strategy through to sustainment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Change Strategy \& Planning** 



* Define the overall change approach for the engagement, tailored to the client's culture, change maturity, program scope, and risk profile.
* Develop the change management plan covering stakeholder engagement, communications, training, business readiness, adoption, and sustainment.
* Align the change plan with the program delivery plan, milestones, and dependencies.



**Change Impact Assessment** 



* Conduct detailed change impact assessments across affected roles, teams, processes, systems, policies, and locations.
* Quantify the size, complexity, and severity of change ("from / to" analysis) and use this to shape intervention intensity.
* Maintain a living change impact register and surface risks to program leadership.



**Stakeholder Analysis \& Engagement** 



* Identify, map, and segment stakeholder groups by influence, interest, impact, and disposition.
* Design and execute tailored engagement approaches for each group — from executive sponsors to frontline end users.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships across the client organisation, including with resistant or sceptical stakeholders.



**Sponsor \& Leader Enablement**

jobs.description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a Governance Specialist / Senior Business Analyst to build and operate data governance across our data estate, and to work with business teams to translate their needs into governance policies that are practical and enforceable. The role combines hands\-on tooling work with requirements gathering and stakeholder management, sitting at the intersection of business, data, and governance. Because our environment spans multiple platforms, you'll help determine the right control for the right context rather than applying a single fixed approach.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Build and operate data governance across cataloging, classification, lineage, glossary, and policy, using the platform best suited to each need (see stack below).
* Assess current data practices, identify gaps, and design governance components to address them.
* Gather requirements from business and data teams and translate them into governance policies, standards, and tool configuration.
* Define data ownership, stewardship, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs) across key domains.
* Establish data classification, sensitivity labels, access policies, and compliance controls (GDPR, DPDP, SOX, HIPAA, as applicable).
* Implement data quality rules — including profiling, validation, and KPI dashboards — and drive issues to resolution.
* Facilitate governance forums and working groups, and support internal users in adopting the framework.
* Partner with data engineering, security, and compliance teams to embed governance into day\-to\-day data pipelines.



**Our stack** 




 Experience with all of these is not expected; please indicate which you have worked with.
 


* **Cataloging \& governance:** 
 Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Informatica
* **Data platforms:** 
 Databricks (Unity Catalog), Snowflake (Horizon), Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse / ADF
* **Data security \& DSPM:** 
 Concentric AI, BigID, Securiti, Immuta, Varonis
* **Quality \& observability:** 
 Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations



**What you'll bring** 



* 5\+ years in data governance and/or business analysis, ideally with experience across both.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise governance or cataloging tool (Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar), and the ability to become proficient with others.
* Working knowledge of a modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, or equivalent).
* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Solid understanding of metadata management, data quality, MDM, and access/policy governance.
* Exposure to data security and DSPM tooling (Concentric, BigID, Immuta, or similar) is a strong advantage.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data, IT, or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and Agile delivery.



**Nice to have** 



* Certifications such as CDMP (DAMA), Microsoft or Databricks data certifications, or CBAP.
* Experience in \[your industry — BFSI, healthcare, etc.]

 Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) supports every business line and geography across Amazon — paying Vendors and Suppliers (Procure to Pay), collecting cash (Order to Cash), and paying employees (Payroll) on time, accurately, and with the best experience. As Amazon grows, so does the demand for FinOps services — and we're fundamentally rethinking how we deliver them.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We're recruiting a Senior Business Analyst for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) who will combine deep BA expertise with a forward\-looking mandate — designing, deploying, and scaling AI agents that automate repeatable analysis tasks and accelerate delivery for our customers across the organization. You'll define the strategy for how AI transforms business analysis delivery, build intelligent workflows that compress timelines from weeks to days, and drive adoption across teams — while applying your expertise where it matters most: solving ambiguous problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and making strategic trade\-offs that AI can't.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who can operate independently with limited guidance, manage the lifecycle of complex initiatives across multiple teams, and shape how an entire organization delivers.

* Architect intelligent workflows that automate repeatable BA tasks at scale — requirements drafting, validation, traceability, impact analysis — compressing delivery timelines organization\-wide
* Establish governance frameworks ensuring AI\-generated outputs meet controllership standards, and iterate on agent performance based on measurable outcomes
* Force\-multiply by enabling other BAs and PMs to leverage AI tools effectively — building the mechanisms, guidelines, and training that make the capability self\-sustaining


 Program Leadership \& Complex Problem Solving
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional initiatives spanning multiple teams and business units — from strategy definition through execution and post\-launch measurement
* Navigate ambiguity: define program scope, success criteria, and execution plans where the business problem or solution may not be well\-defined

* Set the standard for requirements analysis across the team — ensuring completeness, consistency, feasibility, and verifiability at scale
* Translate complex business and customer needs into actionable specifications grounded in data, and influence roadmap priorities based on business impact
* Create and refine standardized BA processes, artifacts, and mechanisms that raise team maturity and effectiveness across the organization


 Stakeholder Influence \& Communication
   

  

* Partner with and influence senior leaders on priorities, resource allocation, and strategic direction
* Drive alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities — building consensus and resolving contention constructively
* Communicate effectively in writing and verbally to Directors and VPs — narratives, business cases, program reviews, and escalations


 Business Process Analysis \& Optimization
   

  

* Evaluate end\-to\-end business processes across AP, AR, and Compliance verticals — identifying automation opportunities that significantly reduce cycle times and eliminate unnecessary process
* Streamline and simplify: judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures to increase team productivity and delivery speed
* Analyze data and metrics to identify trends, measure impact, and drive decisions

 A Day in the Life
   

  

 You operate at both the strategic and tactical level. You might start the day reviewing AI agent performance metrics and refining automation workflows, then shift to facilitating a cross\-functional alignment session where you're driving consensus across teams with competing priorities. You present a program narrative to a Director, then coach a BA on how to leverage AI tools for a complex requirements effort.

Working at the frontier of Agent Experience (AX) : designing for a largely headless, invisible\-UI world where the "user" is often code acting with intent, not a person.



You'll join a small pod of PMs and engineers actively defining Auth0's agentic vision from scratch — there's no existing pattern library, so you'll help create it: how agents sign up, authenticate, execute tasks, and how humans stay in control without micromanaging them.



Alongside this, you'll own signup and onboarding design for a new customer: the AI\-powered developer, whose workflows involve agents and automated tooling from day one. The same instincts that build trust for a human overseeing an agent also build trust for a developer signing up for a self\-serve product. We're looking for a self\-starter who generates their own hypotheses and builds the roadmap as they go.

  


**What You'll Do**


**Agent Experience (AX)**


* Shape Auth0's agentic vision alongside a small, fast\-moving team of PMs and engineers.


* Define the "what" for agents — interaction models for signup, execution, and backend operations, largely invisible to a screen.


* Define the "how" for humans — trust, transparency, and control (errors, edge cases, audit trails) for orchestrating agents.


* Identify the problems worth solving yourself; establish patterns and protocols others adopt.


* Own the full lifecycle: definition, prototyping, validation, iteration.

  


**Growth \& Onboarding (DLG)**


* Define signup and onboarding for the AI\-powered developer — rethinking self\-service as workflows become increasingly automated.


* Own subscription, pricing \& packaging strategy end to end; shape the Growth roadmap with Product and Engineering.


* Define how design impact is measured (e.g., via Pendo, Heap); lead research and turn insight into action.


* Simplify high\-leverage developer workflows into elegant, self\-service experiences.

  


**Craft \& Influence**


* Be a thought partner to the design manager; raise the craft bar across the Global Design Team.


* Mentor designers; translate AI/technical concepts into practical guidance for PMs and engineers.


* Represent design in roadmap discussions for both AX and Growth.

  


**Who You Are**


* 10\+ years of human\-centered product design experience with a portfolio showing strategic ownership and strong craft.


* A true self\-starter — you've built experiences or practices from scratch, without a roadmap handed to you.


* Comfortable designing for headless, low\-UI, API\-first surfaces.


* Experience designing for AI agents or agentic systems is a huge plus — you've tackled invisible\-UI, trust, or automation problems before, not just discussed them.


* Track record owning onboarding/self\-service experiences at scale, backed by PLG and conversion metrics fluency (Pendo, Heap, or similar).


* Comfortable in ambiguity, technical conversations, and fast\-moving, undefined team settings.


* A multiplier — you elevate others and build alignment without formal authority.


* Bonus: engineering/front\-end background.

 **Why Join Us**


* Help write the vision, not just implement it — a founding voice on AX and Growth


* Shape two frontiers at once: invisible AX for agents, and growth for AI\-powered developers.


* Operate at staff scope, with real influence over strategy and craft.


* We believe in augmentation, not replacement — and in design as problem\-solving, not artifacts.


* Be a founder of a new discipline, architecting how growth and agentic systems work together.

 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
   

  

 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The
 **Asset Protection (AP) Experience Product team** 
 is accountable for products and capabilities that help create a secure shopping and working environment for guests and team members while protecting Target’s profitability through strategies that reduce shortage. These experiences support AP workflows across Stores and GSCL locations, including surveillance, shortage leads, documentation, security prevention and resolution, and video\-enabled investigation, while also enabling enterprise teams to leverage AP capabilities such as surveillance when needed. Through innovative, integrated, and intuitive user experiences, the team drives outcomes that strengthen AP effectiveness and create value across Target.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a
 **Product Manager – Video/ Theia Platform** 
 , you will own the India\-based product execution for the core video platform capabilities that power Target’s surveillance experiences and enable video to be easily accessed, used, and integrated across enterprise product workflows. Theia supports users across Stores, GSCL locations, HQ, and enterprise teams who rely on video for monitoring, investigations, evidence capture, event review, operational visibility, and shortage and security workflows.
   

  

 This role will partner closely with U.S. product partners, engineering, UX, infrastructure, and enterprise product teams to evolve Theia as a flexible, scalable, and resilient enterprise video platform. You will help deliver and improve capabilities such as streaming, playback, retention, camera configuration, audit, permissions, health monitoring, and integrations that make video available to downstream product experiences. You will also help shape future platform needs, including compute capabilities, scale, resiliency, and secure access patterns that allow video to be leveraged more effectively across Target.
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.
   

  

 You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
   

  

 You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

jobs.title: Product Strategy Lead, Developer Device Platform
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross\-functional programs or projects.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in program management, strategy, or business operations in the technology sector.
* Experience developing and executing go\-to\-market strategies, managing vendor ecosystems, and driving engagement with key customers.
* Experience in change management and communication strategy.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to construct, articulate, and defend simple messages or insights from analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



OmniLab's mission is to connect developers with devices at scale. We are building a vertically integrated developer device platform that allows both internal and external developers to access the physical or virtual devices they need, right when they need them. Our work is critical to the success of nearly every product at Google, from Android and Pixel to Google Cloud and AI.


As a Product Strategy Lead in the OmniLab team, you will be at the heart of our startup within Google. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our customers, our operations, and our overall business strategy. You will solve complex problems and build strong relationships.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and lead the strategic direction for OmniLab’s business operations, focusing on vendor ecosystem optimization, go\-to\-market execution, and strategic customer engagement.
* Own the development and execution of a comprehensive Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategy to establish our brand, enable channel partners, and drive adoption.
* Lead engagement for strategic customers and key verticals. Develop a joint GTM motion with partners and act as the ultimate customer advocate to translate needs into actionable strategies, which may require flexibility to support global customer conversations, including some overlap with US business hours.
* Lead large\-scale, ambiguous, and cross\-functional programs that directly impact business growth, operational efficiency, and customer success, driving alignment from strategy through to execution.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:

Koch Ag \& Energy Solutions (KAES) is seeking a highly motivated **Full Stack Software Engineer** to design, develop, and deliver scalable, cloud\-native applications that create value for our customers and business partners. * Experience supporting highly available and scalable enterprise applications

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting- Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for:**

The purpose of the job is to provide end to end support to investment company clients for timely completion of preparation of financial statements, portfolio schedules and associated mandatory reporting’s within stringent deadlines for audit / review and successful submission to the regulators.


Selected candidates will be required to work at shifts which allow reasonable overlap with US, APAC and EMEA hours and allow for trainings, on the job practice, feedback etc.


**Why this role is important to us:**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.


Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.


**What you will be responsible for:**

As Senior Associate you will:


* Prepare and perform 1st level reviews on client financial statements, NQs, Form N\-MFP other similar forms/activities and clear comments and assist with draft and support distribution to client and auditors, ensuring that all deliverables are completed accurately and within agreed upon time
* Provide on\-the\-job training and coaching to all staff in addition provide performance feedback to manager for review
* Responsible for risk management by ensuring staff understands all Standard Operating procedures, Key Controls, and Client Specific Procedures/Checklists
* Estimate personnel needs, assign work, oversee short term deliverables, coordinate workflow, maintain working knowledge of overall process operating model while assisting with deployment of operational changes
* Ensure team is achieving accuracy and meeting pre\-determined deadlines
* Implement all standard practices, processes, tools, and technology enhancements
* Effectively use automation and make recommendations for current system enhancements
* Participate in the research and resolution of client issues
* Volunteer for ad\-hoc projects and help with last minute requests
* Resolve issues and prioritize actions in the absence of the direct manager
* Assist with coordination of activities between multiple departments within the organization, including our global offshoring partners
* Draft and update task lists for offshoring partners, ensures all supporting documentation is available to them and acts as primary contact to answer their questions and issues

**What we value:**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Fund Accounting
* Transaction processing \& Management
* Financial Analysis
* Excellent communication skills
* Problem solving
* Statistical analysis

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce / Economics with a specialization in Business, Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience preferred.
* CA / CPA / ACCA or similar professional qualification preferred
* Knowledge of US GAAP/ IFRS etc.

**Additional requirements:**

* Demonstrates strong technology skills, as well as problem solving and analytical skills
* Demonstrates an ability to be a leader within their team, as well as be a leader amongst your peers
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, which includes excellent time management skills
* 4\+ years to 6\+ years of experience in Fund Financial Reporting /accounting or finance field preferred

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.


**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.


**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full pot…

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer (AI Enablement Focus)
jobs.description:
**Job Role:** SeniorData Engineer (AI Enablement Focus)  

**Location:** Bangalore

**ABOUT UNILEVER**  

With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.  

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

**ABOUT GDT:**


GDT is the global digital and technology engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. GDT serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

**About Us:**  

Wild are on a mission to remove single\-use plastic from the bathroom, armed with our refillable, natural and scent\-sational deodorants, body wash, and lip balm – and we’re only just getting started. We launched in 2020 and as a high\-growth company we’re already one of Europe’s fastest growing start\-ups.  

  

**Role Summary**


Autonomous agents are only as good as the data they can reason over and act on. The Data Engineer (AI Enablement Focus) builds and maintains the semantic data layer that makes Wild's agents accurate, grounded, and trustworthy — with Snowflake as the core data source, optimised specifically for AI consumption.


This is a specialised data engineering role aimed at the AI use case rather than traditional BI. You will design pipelines and data products that feed retrieval and agent workflows, prepare and structure data for embeddings/RAG, and ensure freshness, quality, and lineage. You are the bridge between Wild's raw data estate and the agents that depend on it.


You will also be a guardian of data governance: ensuring access controls, privacy, and quality standards are met so that agents can be deployed safely at scale. Your work directly determines how reliable and explainable the agents can be.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Optimise Snowflake for AI consumption: semantic modelling, performance tuning, and structuring data for retrieval and agent use.
* Build and maintain data pipelines (batch and near\-real\-time) that supply agents with fresh, reliable data.
* Prepare data for RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector storage, and metadata for grounded retrieval.
* Create reusable data products and curated datasets for agent workflows.
* Implement data quality, validation, and lineage so agent outputs are trustworthy and auditable.
* Enforce data governance: access control, privacy/PII handling, and compliance in partnership with governance teams.
* Integrate Snowflake with GCP services and the agent platform securely and efficiently.
* Monitor and tune pipeline cost and performance alongside FinOps.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 10\+ years of overall experience
* 4\+ years in data engineering, with strong Snowflake expertise (modelling, performance, security).
* Advanced SQL and advanced proficiency in Python for data pipelines.
* Experience with the modern data stack and pipeline (dbt, fivetran etc).
* Experience building production data pipelines and orchestration (e.g. dbt, Airflow, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of GCP data services and Snowflake–cloud integration.
* Understanding of RAG data preparation: embeddings, vector stores, chunking, and metadata.
* Strong grasp of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
* Awareness of privacy/security requirements for enterprise data.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience enabling AI/ML or LLM workloads specifically (feature/retrieval pipelines).
* Snowflake and/or GCP certifications.
* Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search.
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
 **Key Success Metrics**

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly organised and commercially aware
 **Product Owner** 
 to drive product development, delivery, and continuous improvement across our portfolio.
   

  

 Acting as the vital link between Technology, Sales, Programs, Marketing, Service, and R\&D teams, you will be responsible for managing and prioritising the product backlog, translating business needs into clear requirements, and ensuring the successful delivery of product initiatives aligned to business goals.
   

  

 You will also play a key role in supporting customer tenders and proposals, articulating product capabilities and technical specifications while ensuring solutions deliver maximum value to both customers and the business.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
**Product Backlog Management**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring clarity, prioritisation, and alignment with business goals.
* Define and refine user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria to guide development teams.
* Continuously groom and maintain the backlog to reflect changing priorities and stakeholder feedback.
* Prioritise product initiatives based on business value, feasibility, and strategic impact.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, customers, and development teams.
* Collaborate across Technology, Sales, Programs, Marketing, Service, and R\&D to support the creation of product technical specifications.
* Facilitate effective communication to ensure alignment of expectations, priorities, and outcomes.
* Present product updates, progress, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams.


**Development \& Delivery**
* Partner closely with development teams to support planning and execution activities.
* Provide timely clarification and decision\-making support during development cycles.
* Monitor progress, remove blockers where possible, and adjust priorities to maximise value delivery.
* Validate deliverables against defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.


**Value Delivery \& Continuous Improvement**
* Measure and track product performance against agreed KPIs and success measures.
* Analyse customer and stakeholder feedback to inform future enhancements and iterations.

**Key Competencies**
* Strong programme, project, and time management skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Proven ability to work effectively in matrixed, global, and virtual teams.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making capability, able to evaluate information and act in complex environments.
* Commercially aware with a strong understanding of business objectives and market dynamics.
* Excellent relationship\-building, collaboration, and influencing skills.
* Ability to drive results, support change, and champion continuous improvement.

* Resourceful, inquisitive, and skilled at translating information into actionable insights.

**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands—from checkout optimization and reducing return\-to\-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes around $2B in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI\-powered infrastructure. As we expand our product ecosystem, we're investing in a robust platform foundation that enables faster innovation, greater scalability, and seamless experiences across all our products.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As the Senior Director – Platform Product Management, you will define and lead the strategy for the shared platform that powers GoKwik's entire product ecosystem. This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for building reusable platform capabilities that accelerate product development, improve reliability, and ensure consistency across merchant experiences.
   

  

 Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Security, and Business leaders, you will drive platform adoption, establish governance, and shape the long\-term technical foundation that enables GoKwik to scale efficiently across products, merchants, and commerce platforms.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

 Platform Strategy \& Vision
   

  

* Define the long\-term vision, roadmap, and priorities for GoKwik's platform ecosystem.
* Build reusable platform capabilities that enable multiple product teams to innovate faster.
* Balance short\-term business priorities with long\-term platform investments and technical scalability.


 Shared Platform Capabilities
   

  

* Own shared services, APIs, data contracts, common workflows, and reusable platform components.
* Drive platform standardization across authentication, data models, integrations, infrastructure, and developer tooling.
* Ensure platform capabilities support multiple merchant environments, including Shopify, custom storefronts, and other eCommerce platforms.


 Cross\-Functional Product Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Product leaders to ensure new features are designed for extensibility, reusability, and multi\-platform compatibility.
* Review product requirements and technical designs to ensure alignment with platform standards.
* Make strategic decisions on what should become shared platform capabilities versus product\-specific implementations.


 Platform Governance \& Adoption
   

  

* Drive adoption of shared services, APIs, and reusable components across engineering and product teams.
* Reduce duplicate systems, fragmented implementations, and one\-off product builds.
* Establish governance processes around platform standards, architecture reviews, migration plans, and exception management.
* Define and monitor platform success metrics across adoption, reliability, migration progress, platform velocity, and internal customer satisfaction.


 Platform Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Own visibility into platform migrations, dependencies, milestones, risks, and execution plans.
* Partner with Engineering leaders on architecture, scalability, reliability, observability, deployment strategies, and platform SLAs.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering, BI, AI, Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to embed governance, privacy, consent, and regulatory requirements into platform design.
* Improve internal developer experience through better documentation, discoverability, onboarding, and platform usability.
* Lead cross\-functional operating cadences, including roadmap reviews, design reviews, adoption reviews, and stakeholder communication.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 10–15 years of product management experience, with 5–8\+ years leading platform products or technically complex product areas.
* Proven experience building platform products within B2B SaaS, fintech, commerce infrastructure, payments, developer platforms, API platforms, data platforms, or shared\-services environments.
* Strong technical product expertise across APIs, distributed systems, platform architecture, data flows, scalability, reliability, and platform trade\-offs.
* Comfortable partnering with senior Engineering leaders and contributing meaningfully to architecture and technical design discussions.
* Experienced in driving platform adoption across multiple product and engineering teams without direct authority.
* Strong product judgment with the ability to balance business priorities, platform investments, compliance, and engineering constraints.

About ECI
  
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid\-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses.
